{{Quote|&hellip;he found me after the skirmish on Cholganna. Most of us were killed, but he spared me. He offered me a place by his side.|translated=1|Qawohl, on his master, Teneb Kel|<ref name="BotE 2" />}}
The '''skirmish on Cholganna''' was a conflict fought sometime before [[3678 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> The skirmish was waged by agents of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], and resulted in the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of many of the [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] [[Qawohl]]'s comrades. In the aftermath of the struggle, the [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] [[Darth Thanaton|Teneb Kel]] discovered Qawohl and spared his life, taking him from [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]] as a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] and familiar.<ref name="BotE 2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The skirmish on Cholganna was first mentioned in ''[[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 2: The Broken World]]'', the second issue of the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire|''Blood of the Empire'']] [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]]. The event was alluded to by the Abyssin slave Qawohl; however, no information was provided on who was involved in the skirmish other than the Sith Imperials and Qawohl himself.
